description: This file defines API endpoints for a FastAPI web service handling predictions related to flood risk, terrain segmentation, sponge-zone detection, and GeoJSON outputs. It includes route handlers for flood risk prediction, segmentation, terrain analysis, and sponge zone GeoJSON generation, utilizing multiple ML models and data processing functions.

classes.name: FloodRiskRequest
classes.description: Schema for flood risk prediction request, containing climate index sequences.

classes.name: FloodRiskResponse
classes.description: Schema for flood risk prediction response, including flood probability and rainfall forecast.

classes.name: SegmentationResponse
classes.description: Schema for terrain segmentation response, including image mask and proportions.

classes.name: TerrainAnalysisResponse
classes.description: Schema combining segmentation, sponge zones, and summary statistics for terrain analysis.

classes.name: GeoJSONFeatureCollection
classes.description: Schema for GeoJSON FeatureCollection representing sponge zones in pixel coordinates.

methods.name: FloodRiskResponse predict_flood_risk(req: FloodRiskRequest)
methods.description: Endpoint for predicting flood risk using Model A based on climate sequences.

methods.name: SegmentationResponse predict_segmentation_api(file: UploadFile = File(...))
methods.description: Endpoint for segmenting terrain images using Model B, supporting image uploads.

methods.name: TerrainAnalysisResponse predict_terrain_analysis( file: UploadFile = File(...), include_mask: bool = Query( default=True, description="If false, the API will still compute zones but return an empty mask to reduce payload size.", ), )
methods.description: Endpoint that performs terrain segmentation and sponge-zone detection, returning combined results.

methods.name: GeoJSONFeatureCollection predict_sponge_zones_geojson(file: UploadFile = File(...))
methods.description: Endpoint generating GeoJSON polygons for detected sponge zones in the image.
